children: Thailand's customs-cleared exports (THCEX=ECI) rose 27.5% in October from a year earlier, the commerce ministry said on Friday, higher than analysts' expectations.
The October reading compared with a forecast increase of 26.2% in a Reuters poll.
Imports (THCIM=ECI) rose 53.2% in October from a year earlier.
